name: b2ige-verify
description: Independent deterministic verification for AI-written software.
long_description: Don't trust done. Prove it. Local stdio MCP for approved BlindTest hidden CLI invariants, BehaviorSeal regression checks, and SideEffect durable SQLite evidence. Supports macOS arm64/x86_64 and GNU/Linux x86_64 only; other OS/architectures fail closed. Uses unchanged v0.1.0 native binaries. Requires a trusted operator registry with absolute configuration paths; BlindTest additionally requires Docker and protected sealed storage. No telemetry, API key, or hosted service. Installation and doctor readiness never mean PASS; bounded verification is not exhaustive proof.

registry.title: Trusted operator registry
registry.description: Absolute path to a reviewed project.json. Use absolute config/storage paths. Do not use an agent-writable registry.

sealed_root.title: BlindTest sealed root (only for BlindTest)
sealed_root.description: Absolute protected directory outside the coding workspace. Required for BlindTest; leave empty for BehaviorSeal/SideEffect only.
